text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. It allows machines to read text and find meaning in it, which is called text understanding. NLP also powers translation tools that change words from one language to another. Another useful example is sentiment analysis, where a computer decides if a piece of writing is positive, negative, or neutral. Finally, chatbots use NLP to talk with people and answer their questions. Thanks to NLP, we can communicate with technology in a more natural and helpful way every day.
